name: Maria-sama ga Gyakuten
source:
Feat. characters of Maria-sama ga *iteru and Pho*ix Wright, focusing on a trial. You play a defense attorney Aweketta to save a culprit Defendia.

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE025307.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一部以《玛丽亚大人》与《逆转裁判》角色为主角、聚焦庭审的作品。玩家将扮演辩护律师绫薙，拯救被告Defendia。
